meta.purpose: what each RSNA journal asks of each article type, for a LaTeX manuscript template; the one place where a limit or a required section is written
meta.read_this_first: No page of pubs.rsna.org or academic.oup.com could be opened on the day: they refuse automated readers. Every number here came through the web search tool's copy of the official page, a browser print of 2025-09-18 kept by a third party (Radiology only), or measurements of printed articles. Nothing is graded A except what rsna.org itself served. An author checks the journal's own page before submitting.
meta.field_shape: every fact is {value, source, read, via, grade} with optional note, also, official_page; 'source' is the address, 'read' the date, 'via' a key of the top-level 'via' table, 'grade' a key of 'grades'; value null means the page does not give it or it could not be read, never a guess
meta.journal_level_fields: under journals[].journal_level: title_word_limit, title_page_split, anonymisation, abbreviations, manuscript_file_order, separate_files, file_type, font, spacing, page_numbers, line_numbers, authorship, statements {funding, disclosures, data_sharing, code_availability, generative_ai, reporting_checklists, trial_registration, ethics_approval}
meta.no_pasted_text: the instruction pages' own sentences are not reproduced here: each fact is stated in plain words with the address of the page it was read from

grades.A: read on the official site itself on the date given
grades.B: read in a full copy of the official page (the browser print of 2025-09-18), or the same value in two or more separate answers of the search tool about the official page, or one such answer in the page's own words that the journal's printed articles agree with. Agreement between answers shows that the copy was read steadily, not that the copy is current
grades.C: one answer of the search tool only, or an answer that was ambiguous; confirm on the live page first
grades.P: measured from the journal's printed articles; shows what is printed after editing, not what the instructions ask

via.direct: the page itself, read on the date given (HTTP 200)
via.search-copy: the web search tool's copy of the official page; the live page refused automated reading on the date given (HTTP 403, Cloudflare challenge), so the date is the day the copy was consulted, and the copy may be older than the live page
via.print-2025-09-18: a browser print of the official page dated 2025-09-18 (PDF metadata), kept by a third party and read in full on the date given; the live page refused automated reading
via.measured: measured on the date given from the journal's printed articles through the public NCBI interface (PubMed records, PubMed Central full texts); practice, not an instruction
